newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hotel Grand Central to raise funds.
newsitem.headline: Hotel Grand Central to raise funds.

text.p: Hotel Grand Central Ltd said on Tuesday it proposed to issue 36.69 million warrants together with term loan facility of Australian $20 Million and Singapore $15 million.
The warrants will be issued on the basis of one warrant for every five shares held, the company said in a statement.
It said funds raised would be used by the company to partially fund the acquisition of Orchard Hotel and Orchard Retail centre in Perth, Australia and to partially repay some borrowings.
As of December 31, 1996, the borrowings of the group amounted to about S$92.1 million.
The proposals are subject to approval from shareholders and the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
